```{r}
set.seed(456)

n<- 100
x0<- 0

epsilon<- rnorm(n,mean = 0,sd=1)
epsilon

# initiallize the random walk
random_walk=numeric(n)
random_walk[1]<- x0

# stimulatte the random walk
for (t in 2:n){
  random_walk[t]<- random_walk[t-1]+epsilon[t]
}

#plot the random walk
plot(random_walk,type="l",col="blue",lwd=2,main="simple random walk", xlab="time",ylab="value")
diff(random_walk)-> t
plot(t)


```

```{r}
acf(t)
```
